title: Human Diseases Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Zoology Human Diseases Chapter

cards.q: What is the causative agent of Typhoid?
Which mosquito acts as the vector for Malaria?
What is the vector for Kala Azar?
Which vitamin deficiency causes Scurvy and malformation of teeth and gums?
Who discovered Vitamin C and in which year?
Pellagra is caused by the deficiency of which B-complex vitamin?
What is the normal average blood pressure in humans and what instrument is used to measure it?
cards.a: 120/80 mm Hg; measured by a Sphygmomanometer.

cards.q: Which type of lens is used to correct Myopia (short-sightedness)?
In which year did the State AIDS cell start functioning in Tamil Nadu?
At what age is the MMR vaccination recommended under the National Immunisation Programme?
Where and when was the Zika Virus first identified?
Which disease is caused by the SARS Corona virus and originated in Southern China in 2002?
What is the specific congenital defect caused in infants if the mother is infected with the Zika Virus during pregnancy?
Which helminth causes Elephantiasis (Filariasis) and what is its vector?
cards.a: Wuchereria bancrofti; Vector is the Female Culex mosquito.

cards.q: What are the primary symptoms of Kwashiorkor protein deficiency?
cards.a: Muscles become thin, while the face and stomach become bulgy.
